title: Mempool Surf Club Explore — Master Registry
scope: Research-only federated master registry. No merge, publication, Atlas/Shopify wiring, routes, or production changes are authorized.

source_model.rule: The master registry indexes eight byte-preserved approved category registries. Category manifests and shards retain canonical research payloads; this layer owns cross-category identity, canonical-home decisions, aggregate counts, and integration provenance.
source_model.record_identity: Preserve category Registry IDs; do not renumber into a second master ID system.
source_model.canonical_profile_rule: One canonical profile per materially distinct entity, protocol, product, or system. Same-brand products may remain separate only when function, lifecycle, custody/trust model, protocol role, or user-facing system is materially distinct.
source_model.relationships_rule: Cross-category relevance is represented by relationships rather than duplicate canonical profiles.
